title: Peel Hard-Boiled Eggs Over the Trash
summary: Peeling cooked eggs by hand over an open kitchen trash can, then rinsing and setting them aside.

nodes.name: Take cooled eggs from container
nodes.instruction_novice: Grab the cooled hard-boiled eggs from the fridge or bowl. Cold eggs peel more easily.
nodes.end_state: Hands hold the eggs or a bag of eggs.

checks.question: Is this step done: Take cooled eggs from container?

nodes.name: Open the trash can lid
nodes.instruction_novice: Step on the pedal or lift the lid so the trash can is open beneath you.
nodes.end_state: Trash can is open with its liner visible below the hands.

checks.question: Is this step done: Open the trash can lid?

nodes.name: Crack the egg shell
nodes.instruction_novice: Tap the egg gently on a hard surface or squeeze it so the shell cracks all over.
nodes.end_state: Egg shell shows a web of cracks.

checks.question: Is this step done: Crack the egg shell?

nodes.name: Start peel at the wide end
nodes.instruction_novice: Find the air pocket at the wider end and lift off the first piece of shell with your thumb.
nodes.end_state: A patch of white egg is exposed at the wide end.

checks.question: Is this step done: Start peel at the wide end?

nodes.name: Peel off remaining shell
nodes.instruction_novice: Work your thumb under the membrane and pull the shell away in large pieces, letting them drop into the trash.
nodes.end_state: Egg is fully white and smooth with shell pieces in the trash.

checks.question: Is this step done: Peel off remaining shell?

nodes.name: Repeat for remaining eggs
nodes.instruction_novice: Do the same crack and peel for each of the other eggs.
nodes.end_state: All eggs are peeled and held or set aside.

checks.question: Is this step done: Repeat for remaining eggs?

nodes.name: Rinse peeled eggs
nodes.instruction_novice: Run the peeled eggs under cool water to wash off any small shell bits.
nodes.end_state: Clean, shell-free eggs sit wet under the faucet.

checks.question: Is this step done: Rinse peeled eggs?

nodes.name: Close trash and store eggs
nodes.instruction_novice: Close the trash lid and put the eggs in a bowl or container for eating or storage.
nodes.end_state: Trash lid is closed and peeled eggs rest in a container.

checks.question: Is this step done: Close trash and store eggs?

nodes.name: Wash your hands
nodes.instruction_novice: Wash your hands with soap and water to finish up.
nodes.end_state: Hands are being rinsed at the sink.

checks.question: Is this step done: Wash your hands?
